nodes.title: Prompt upsampler
widgets_values:
**Prompt upsampler.** Type a short edit request in **Request**, with `<Picture 1>` for the image to edit and `<Picture 2>` for the reference. The upsampler (Generate Text) sees both images and turns the request into an edit brief, shown in the preview.

For another number of images, add or remove a `<Picture N>: <|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>` block in **Upsampler input** the image in **Batch Images**, padded to image_1's size, and the image on **p-h3-image Conditioning**.

**image_1 at 4 MP** sets the size of the edit.

Set **Use prompt upsampler** to false to send the request to the model as it is.
